svg.aria-label: A block of 96 threads becomes three full warps: threads 0 to 31, 32 to 63 and 64 to 95. A block of 100 threads becomes four warps: three full ones, and warp 3 with 4 lanes used and 28 idle, which still takes a whole warp's place on the SM.
svg.text: A block is cut into warps of 32 threads
Threads 0 to 31 form warp 0, threads 32 to 63 warp 1, and so on.
warp 3: 4 lanes used, 28 idle, a whole warp's place
